ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior routing rationale: the two models are essentially tied on measured capability for this kind of explanatory task (eval differences are within run-to-run variance, and preferences are explicitly dissociated from output quality). With quality a wash, I broke the tie on self-reported task fit — the query is friendly in tone and somewhat open-ended, and Avocet reports a positive preference for warm, generative work, whereas Willet reports an aversion to higher-latitude tasks. Routing to the model that "prefers" the task costs nothing on quality and is a reasonable tiebreaker.
